description: Fixed-income engine. Price plain coupon bonds, solve for yield to maturity, measure interest-rate sensitivity via Macaulay and modified duration and convexity, and build a HIBOR/HKD-style term structure: bootstrap a zero curve from par rates, infer forward rates, and discount cash flows on the curve. Use this for vanilla bonds, rate risk and discount curves; for convertibles use calculate_convertible_bond and for structured payoffs use calculate_structured_product. Methods: bond_price/duration/convexity: face, coupon_rate, years, ytm, frequency; bond_yield: face, coupon_rate, years, price, frequency; matrix_pricing: target_tenor, benchmark_tenors, benchmark_yields; discount_factor: rate, years, frequency; zero_curve: par_rates, tenors, frequency; forward_rate: zero_rates, tenors, t1, t2; pv_curve: cash_flows, times, zero_rates, tenors. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

benchmark_tenors.description: Benchmark tenors in years, sorted, aligned with benchmark_yields.

benchmark_yields.description: Benchmark yields (decimal) at each benchmark tenor.

cash_flows.description: Projected cash flows in reporting currency, indexed t=1..n.

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

par_rates.description: Par (coupon) rates per tenor, aligned with tenors (decimal).

price.description: Dirty price of the instrument in reporting currency.

t2.description: Forward period end in years (> t1).

target_tenor.description: Target tenor in years for matrix pricing (interpolated).

tenors.description: Tenors in years, aligned with par_rates or zero_rates.

times.description: Cash-flow times in years, aligned with cash_flows.

years.description: Number of projection years n; equal len(cash_flows) when both are supplied.

zero_rates.description: Zero (spot) rates per tenor, decimal, annual compounding.

name: calculate_fixed_income

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

value.description: Primary result: a number for scalar methods, an object for valuation methods.

title: Fixed income and term structure analytics
